# Aquib Alam

> Portfolio and professional profile for Aquib Alam, a full-stack software engineer based in Kolkata, India.

## About

Aquib Alam builds web applications, distributed backend services, and developer tooling using TypeScript, Go, Python, React, and Next.js. His work focuses on clean architecture, reliable APIs, and thoughtful user experiences.
